## Purpose

This page repeats in Python the steps that lead from the death records to the
odds ratios: the selection of deaths, the referent days of the
space-time-stratified case-crossover design, the conditional logistic
regression and the additive interaction measures. The regression is written
here from its likelihood, not taken from a library, so that the comparison with
`survival::coxph` in R is between two independent implementations.

The exposures come from the dataset built on the
[Python exposure page](py_01_exposure.html). Results are compared with the R
tables at each step.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from scipy import stats

ROOT = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / "_quarto.yml").exists())
DERIVED = ROOT / "Data" / "Derived"
TABLES = ROOT / "Output" / "Tables"


def merge_config(base, override):
    """Entries of `override` replace those of `base`, level by level."""
    out = dict(base)
    for key, value in override.items():
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(out.get(key), dict):
            out[key] = merge_config(out[key], value)
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out


CFG = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "config" / "config.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
LOCAL = ROOT / "config" / "local.yml"
if LOCAL.exists():
    CFG = merge_config(CFG, yaml.safe_load(LOCAL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def get_param(*keys):
    """Read one parameter; stop when it is missing or still null."""
    value = CFG
    for key in keys:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get(key) is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Parameter {'$'.join(keys)} is not set in config/config.yml")
        value = value[key]
    return value


def input_path(name):
    root = Path(get_param("paths", "input_root")).expanduser()
    if not root.is_absolute():
        root = ROOT / root
    path = Path(get_param("inputs", name)).expanduser()
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = root / path
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input '{name}' not found: {path}")
    return path


municipalities = pd.read_csv(ROOT / get_param("study", "municipalities_file"))
STUDY_YEARS = get_param("mortality", "years")
WARM_MONTHS = get_param("study", "warm_season_months")
LAGS = get_param("design", "lags_days")
CONF = get_param("models", "conf_level")
Z = stats.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - CONF) / 2)
```

## Deaths

```{python}
#| label: deaths
needed = ["FECHA_DEF", "SEXO_NOMBRE", "EDAD_TIPO", "EDAD_CANT", "COD_COMUNA", "DIAG1"]
raw = pd.read_csv(input_path("deis_deaths"), sep=";", encoding="latin-1", usecols=needed,
                  parse_dates=["FECHA_DEF"])
flow = [("Records in the input file", len(raw))]
deaths = raw.dropna(subset=["FECHA_DEF", "COD_COMUNA"])
flow.append(("With date of death and municipality of residence", len(deaths)))
deaths = deaths[deaths["COD_COMUNA"].isin(municipalities["code"])]
flow.append(("Residents of the 33 study municipalities", len(deaths)))
deaths = deaths[deaths["FECHA_DEF"].dt.year.between(*STUDY_YEARS)]
flow.append((f"Died in {STUDY_YEARS[0]}-{STUDY_YEARS[1]}", len(deaths)))
deaths = deaths[deaths["FECHA_DEF"].dt.month.isin(WARM_MONTHS)].copy()
flow.append(("Died in the warm season (1 November to 31 March)", len(deaths)))

assert deaths["DIAG1"].str.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][0-9]{2}[0-9X]").all()


def icd_key(code3):
    """Numeric key of a three-character ICD-10 category: 'I21' -> 821."""
    return (code3.str[0].map(lambda c: ord(c) - ord("A")) * 100 + code3.str[1:3].astype(int))


key = icd_key(deaths["DIAG1"].str[:3])
for group, ranges in get_param("mortality", "cause_groups").items():
    hit = pd.Series(False, index=deaths.index)
    for item in ranges:
        low, high = item.split("-")
        hit |= key.between(icd_key(pd.Series([low]))[0], icd_key(pd.Series([high]))[0])
    deaths[group] = hit

age = deaths["EDAD_CANT"].where(deaths["EDAD_TIPO"] == 1, 0.0).where(deaths["EDAD_TIPO"].isin([1, 2, 3, 4]))
breaks = get_param("mortality", "age_breaks") + [np.inf]
deaths["age_group"] = pd.cut(age, breaks, labels=get_param("mortality", "age_labels"), right=False)
deaths["sex"] = deaths["SEXO_NOMBRE"].map({"Hombre": "male", "Mujer": "female"}).fillna("undetermined")
deaths = deaths.rename(columns={"FECHA_DEF": "date", "COD_COMUNA": "com"})
flow.append(("Non-accidental cause (A00-R99)", int(deaths["non_accidental"].sum())))
flow.append(("Non-accidental, with age and sex recorded",
             int((deaths["non_accidental"] & deaths["age_group"].notna()
                  & (deaths["sex"] != "undetermined")).sum())))
flow = pd.DataFrame(flow, columns=["step", "deaths_python"])
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-flow
#| tbl-cap: "Selection of deaths: Python against R."
flow_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "mortality_flow.csv").rename(columns={"deaths": "deaths_r"})
flow = flow.merge(flow_r, on="step", validate="1:1")
flow["equal"] = flow["deaths_python"] == flow["deaths_r"]
assert len(flow) == len(flow_r)
flow.style.format({"deaths_python": "{:,}", "deaths_r": "{:,}"}).hide(axis="index")
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-causes
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths by cause group over the 12 years: Python against R."
groups = list(get_param("mortality", "cause_groups"))
causes = pd.DataFrame({"cause": groups, "deaths_python": [int(deaths[g].sum()) for g in groups]})
causes_r = (pd.read_csv(TABLES / "mortality_by_cause_year.csv").groupby("cause")["deaths"].sum()
            .rename("deaths_r").reset_index())
causes = causes.merge(causes_r, on="cause", validate="1:1")
causes["equal"] = causes["deaths_python"] == causes["deaths_r"]
causes.style.format({"deaths_python": "{:,}", "deaths_r": "{:,}"}).hide(axis="index")
```

## Referent days

Deaths of the same municipality and day share their referent days, so the
dataset is built with one row per municipality, day of death and referent day,
weighted by the number of deaths.

```{python}
#| label: referents
def referent_table(selected):
    """One row per municipality, day of death and referent day (same year,
    month and day of the week), with the number of deaths as weight."""
    strata = (selected.groupby(["com", "date"]).size().rename("n_deaths").reset_index()
              .rename(columns={"date": "case_date"}))
    strata["stratum"] = np.arange(len(strata))
    calendar = pd.DataFrame({"date": pd.date_range(strata["case_date"].min() - pd.Timedelta(days=31),
                                                   strata["case_date"].max() + pd.Timedelta(days=31))})
    for frame, column in ((strata, "case_date"), (calendar, "date")):
        frame["yr"], frame["mo"], frame["wd"] = (frame[column].dt.year, frame[column].dt.month,
                                                 frame[column].dt.dayofweek)
    table = strata.merge(calendar, on=["yr", "mo", "wd"])
    table["case"] = (table["date"] == table["case_date"]).astype(int)
    per_stratum = table.groupby("stratum")["case"].agg(["size", "sum"])
    assert (per_stratum["sum"] == 1).all() and per_stratum["size"].isin([4, 5]).all()
    return table.sort_values(["stratum", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)


non_accidental = deaths[deaths["non_accidental"]]
referents = referent_table(non_accidental)
summary = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "case_crossover_summary.csv").set_index("item")["value"]
size = pd.DataFrame({
    "item": ["Deaths (strata)", "Rows (deaths and referent days)"],
    "python": [int(referents.loc[referents["case"] == 1, "n_deaths"].sum()),
               int(referents["n_deaths"].sum())],
})
size["r"] = size["item"].map(summary).astype(int)
size["equal"] = size["python"] == size["r"]
size.style.format({"python": "{:,}", "r": "{:,}"}).hide(axis="index")
```

## Conditional logistic regression from its likelihood

For a stratum $s$ with $w_s$ deaths, day of death $c$ and referent days $j$, the
conditional log-likelihood is

$$\ell(\beta) = \sum_s w_s \left[ x_{sc}^\top \beta - \log \sum_{j \in s} \exp(x_{sj}^\top \beta) \right].$$

The function below maximises it by Newton-Raphson and returns the estimates
with their covariance matrix (the inverse of the observed information).

```{python}
#| label: clogit
def conditional_logit(x, case, stratum, weight):
    """Weighted conditional logistic regression, one case per stratum.
    Rows must be sorted by stratum; `weight` is constant within a stratum."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    starts = np.flatnonzero(np.r_[True, stratum[1:] != stratum[:-1]])
    counts = np.diff(np.r_[starts, len(stratum)])
    w = weight[starts]
    x_case = x[case == 1]
    assert len(x_case) == len(starts)
    beta = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    for _ in range(50):
        eta = x @ beta
        eta = eta - np.repeat(np.maximum.reduceat(eta, starts), counts)
        e = np.exp(eta)
        p = e / np.repeat(np.add.reduceat(e, starts), counts)
        mean_x = np.add.reduceat(p[:, None] * x, starts, axis=0)
        score = (w[:, None] * (x_case - mean_x)).sum(axis=0)
        second = np.add.reduceat(p[:, None, None] * x[:, :, None] * x[:, None, :], starts, axis=0)
        information = np.einsum("s,sjk->jk", w, second - mean_x[:, :, None] * mean_x[:, None, :])
        step = np.linalg.solve(information, score)
        beta = beta + step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-10:
            return beta, np.linalg.inv(information)
    raise RuntimeError("Newton-Raphson did not converge")


def additive_interaction(beta, covariance):
    """REOI, AP and S from the log odds ratios of E10, E01 and E11 (delta method)."""
    or10, or01, or11 = np.exp(beta)
    se = lambda g: float(np.sqrt(np.array(g) @ covariance @ np.array(g)))
    reoi = or11 - or10 - or01 + 1
    ap = reoi / or11
    single, joint = or10 + or01 - 2, or11 - 1
    s = joint / single
    rows = [("REOI", reoi, reoi - Z * se([-or10, -or01, or11]), reoi + Z * se([-or10, -or01, or11])),
            ("AP", ap, *(ap + sign * Z * se([-or10 / or11, -or01 / or11, (or10 + or01 - 1) / or11])
                         for sign in (-1, 1)))]
    if joint > 0 and single > 0:
        se_log_s = se([-or10 / single, -or01 / single, or11 / joint])
        rows.append(("S", s, np.exp(np.log(s) - Z * se_log_s), np.exp(np.log(s) + Z * se_log_s)))
    else:
        rows.append(("S", s, np.nan, np.nan))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["measure", "estimate", "low", "high"])
```

## Models for non-accidental mortality

```{python}
#| label: models
heatwave = get_param("models", "heatwave_main")
ozone_flag = (f"{get_param('air_pollution', 'ozone_series_main')}_"
              f"{get_param('air_pollution', 'interpolation_method_main')}_gt_p"
              f"{get_param('models', 'ozone_cutoff_main')}")
exposure = pd.read_csv(DERIVED / "py_exposure_2009_2020.csv", parse_dates=["date"],
                       usecols=["com", "date", heatwave, ozone_flag])

terms = {"heatwave": ["hw"], "ozone": ["oz"], "joint": ["hw", "oz"], "compound": ["e10", "e01", "e11"]}
or_rows, interaction_rows = [], []
for lag in LAGS:
    lagged = exposure.rename(columns={heatwave: "hw", ozone_flag: "oz"}).copy()
    lagged["date"] = lagged["date"] + pd.Timedelta(days=lag)      # exposure `lag` days earlier
    data = referents.merge(lagged, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="m:1")
    # Strata with an unknown exposure on any referent day are left out, as in R
    incomplete = data.loc[data[["hw", "oz"]].isna().any(axis=1), "stratum"].unique()
    data = data[~data["stratum"].isin(incomplete)].sort_values(["stratum", "date"])
    data["e10"] = ((data["hw"] == 1) & (data["oz"] == 0)).astype(float)
    data["e01"] = ((data["hw"] == 0) & (data["oz"] == 1)).astype(float)
    data["e11"] = ((data["hw"] == 1) & (data["oz"] == 1)).astype(float)
    arrays = (data["case"].to_numpy(), data["stratum"].to_numpy(), data["n_deaths"].to_numpy(float))
    for model, columns in terms.items():
        beta, covariance = conditional_logit(data[columns].to_numpy(), *arrays)
        se = np.sqrt(np.diag(covariance))
        for term, b, s in zip(columns, beta, se):
            or_rows.append({"lag": lag, "model": model, "term": term, "or": np.exp(b),
                            "or_low": np.exp(b - Z * s), "or_high": np.exp(b + Z * s)})
        if model == "compound":
            interaction_rows.append(additive_interaction(beta, covariance).assign(lag=lag))
odds_python = pd.DataFrame(or_rows)
interaction_python = pd.concat(interaction_rows, ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-or
#| tbl-cap: "Odds ratios for non-accidental mortality, working definitions: Python (own Newton-Raphson) against R (survival::coxph)."
odds_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "models_main_or.csv")
odds_r = odds_r[(odds_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental") & (odds_r["subgroup"] == "all")]
odds = odds_python.merge(odds_r[["lag", "model", "term", "or", "or_low", "or_high"]],
                         on=["lag", "model", "term"], suffixes=("_python", "_r"), validate="1:1")
assert len(odds) == len(odds_python) == len(odds_r)
def relative_difference(python_values, r_values):
    """Largest difference by row, relative to the R value when it exceeds one."""
    return (np.abs(python_values - r_values) / np.maximum(1, np.abs(r_values))).max(axis=1)


odds["difference"] = relative_difference(odds[["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python"]].to_numpy(),
                                         odds[["or_r", "or_low_r", "or_high_r"]].to_numpy())
(odds[["lag", "model", "term", "or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r", "difference"]]
 .style.format({c: "{:.4f}" for c in ["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r"]}
               | {"difference": "{:.1e}"}).hide(axis="index"))
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-interaction
#| tbl-cap: "Additive interaction for non-accidental mortality: Python against R."
interaction_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "models_main_interaction.csv")
interaction_r = interaction_r[(interaction_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental")
                              & (interaction_r["subgroup"] == "all")]
interaction = interaction_python.merge(
    interaction_r[["lag", "measure", "estimate", "low", "high"]], on=["lag", "measure"],
    suffixes=("_python", "_r"), validate="1:1")
assert len(interaction) == len(interaction_python)
assert (interaction["low_python"].isna() == interaction["low_r"].isna()).all()
interaction["difference"] = relative_difference(
    interaction[["estimate_python", "low_python", "high_python"]].fillna(0).to_numpy(),
    interaction[["estimate_r", "low_r", "high_r"]].fillna(0).to_numpy())
(interaction[["lag", "measure", "estimate_python", "low_python", "high_python", "estimate_r", "difference"]]
 .style.format({c: "{:.4f}" for c in ["estimate_python", "low_python", "high_python", "estimate_r"]}
               | {"difference": "{:.1e}"}).hide(axis="index"))
```

```{python}
#| label: verdict
worst = max(odds["difference"].max(), interaction["difference"].max())
counts_equal = bool(flow["equal"].all() and causes["equal"].all() and size["equal"].all())
print(f"Counts of deaths and referent rows equal to R: {counts_equal}")
print(f"Largest relative difference with R across odds ratios, interaction measures "
      f"and their confidence limits: {worst:.1e}")
```

The estimates above are the same preliminary results discussed on the
[R models page](05_models.html); this page only establishes that two
independent implementations reach them.
